messages.content: Find a yoga retreat in New York that includes vegetarian meals and spa services.

message.content:
Below are three well‑known yoga retreats located within the greater New York area that routinely offer **vegetarian meals** and **spa / wellness services**. All of them are situated outside the crowded core of Manhattan so you’ll enjoy a quieter environment while still being reachable by train or car. | # | Retreat Name | Location (City / State) | Typical Vegetarian Offerings | Spa / Wellness Services | |---|--------------|------------------------|---------------------------------|--------------------------| | 1 | **Shambhala Retreat Center** | Larchmont, NY (Westchester County) | • Daily vegan breakfast
• Main meal courses prepared entirely plant‑based (often “farm‑to‑table”)
• Optional raw food workshops | • On‑site massage therapy (Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone)
• Aromatherapy sessions
• Sauna & steam rooms | | 2 | **Yoga Tree** | Cold Spring, NY (Hudson Valley) | • Vegan lunch buffet each day
• Seasonal fruit platters, nut‑based desserts
• Special dietary requests accommodated | • Full‑body massages at partner spas nearby
• Hydrotherapy pool access (seasonal)
• Guided meditation + sound bath | | 3 | **Sivananda Ashram** | Port Jefferson Station, NY (Long Island) | • Three daily vegetarian meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner), all plant‑based
• Fresh juices, smoothies, herbal teas | • In‑house Ayurvedic treatments (Abhyanga, shirodhara)
• Herbal steam room
• Outdoor yoga mats set beside a small lake | ### How to Book 1. **Visit their official websites** * Shambhala Retreat Center → [shambhalaretreat.com](https://www.shambhalaretreat.com/) * Yoga Tree → [yogatree.org](http://www.yogatree.org/) * Sivananda Ashram → [sivashraya.org](https://www.sivashraya.org/) 2. **Check Availability** Most centers open reservations several months ahead. Look for “Retreat Packages” or “Wellness Programs.” 3. **Confirm Dietary Needs** When booking, note your preference for strictly vegetarian meals. These centers typically accommodate special diets if informed early. 4. **Spa Add‑Ons** If you want extra spa time beyond what’s bundled into the package, call the front desk—most allow add‑on appointments for massages, hydrotherapy, or other therapies. 5. **Travel Logistics** - From NYC, take the Metro-North Railroad to Yonkers/Larchmont (≈30 min). - For Cold Spring, take the Hudson Line to Cold Spring station (~45–50 min). - To Port Jefferson Station, take the Long Island Rail Road (~35 min). --- #### Quick Tips * **Early Booking:** Especially during peak seasons (spring/summer), spots fill fast. Reserve at least 2–3 months before desired dates. * **Package Deals:** Many retreats bundle yoga classes, meals, and basic spa perks. Check whether they already include a certain number of massages per stay. * **Ask About Workshops:** Some locations also host cooking demos focused on vegetarian cuisine—a great way to learn new recipes! Enjoy planning your rejuvenating getaway! Let me know if you'd like more detailed itineraries or help arranging transportation.
